description: Full-page pre-launch waitlist. No nav/footer — pure conversion. Shows countdown, trust items, and email signup.

brandName.description: Product/brand name shown as the logo/wordmark

spotsLeft.description: Number of early spots remaining — shown as urgency badge

launchDate.description: ISO date string for expected launch — e.g. '2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'

trustItems.description: Short trust signals listed below the form

onSubmit.description: Async handler for email form submit. Resolves on success, throws on error.

submitLabel.description: Submit button text. Default: 'Get early access'

successHeading.description: Heading shown after successful signup. Default: 'Check your inbox'
